recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed unless the work group later chooses to define navigation-link semantics for non-search/history Bundle types.
issue_request: FHIR-38941 was a Published FHIR-core Change Request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking what happens when Bundles that require a specific first entry use navigation links such as next. The approved resolution was to add a Bundle.link note that next/prev/first/last behavior is defined for searchset and history Bundles but not currently defined for other Bundle types, whose behavior must be negotiated by interoperability partners.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Commit df898291c7 added the approved sentence to Bundle.link.definition, and follow-up commit 078e61d079, matching the Jira comment "Git master 078e61d079", moved the sentence into Bundle.link.comment while restoring the concise definition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists bundle=Bundle under [resources], so source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml is current build scope. The current Bundle.link comment contains the approved note. Nearby Bundle narrative mentions next links in the searchset and history sections only, and community/Jira/source searches did not reveal a later or related decision requiring a different current rule. FHIR-I minutes for 2022-10-17 corroborate the Persuasive with Mod vote.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative source already implements the Jira resolution and no source hunk is necessary.
